text:
Based on the 2015 China Global School-based Student Health Survey (GSHS)-style data reported in WHO/CDC adolescent health profiles, roughly 10-15% of students aged 13-15 reported being in a physical fight at school one or more times in the past 12 months. I recall the figure often cited for China around that period as approximately 11-13%. A reasonable single estimate is about 12%.

CONFIDENCE: 55
